description: This file defines an interface for configuring JavaScript message mapping behavior within the Connectivity service, including maximum script size, execution time, and stack depth, along with associated configuration enumeration.

classes.name: JavaScriptConfig
classes.description: Provides configuration settings for Connectivity service's JavaScript message mapping behavior.

classes.name: JavaScriptConfig.JavaScriptConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of configuration path expressions and their default values for JavaScript configuration.

methods.name: getMaxScriptSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum size in bytes for a mapping script to prevent loading large dependencies.

methods.name: getMaxScriptExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed execution time for a script to prevent lengthy or infinite loops.

methods.name: getMaxScriptStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the maximum call stack depth for scripts to prevent recursions or overly complex computations.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Provides the default value for each configuration setting in the enum.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Provides the configuration path expression for each config enum value.
